svg.aria-label: Propranolol, page 3 of 3. Adverse reaction Severe bronchospasm, heart block, severe bradycardia, precipitation of congestive heart failure, and severe rebound hypertension if abruptly withdrawn. Severe bronchospasm, heart block, profound bradycardia, and acute heart failure exacerbation. Side effects Fatigue, cold extremities, sleep disturbances, vivid dreams, depression, and sexual dysfunction. Fatigue, cold extremities, vivid dreams, depression, and sleep disturbances. Special notes Never stop therapy abruptly; beta-blockers must be tapered over 1 to 2 weeks to avoid rebound tachycardia or myocardial ischemia. Must never be discontinued abruptly; tapering over 1 to 2 weeks is mandatory to prevent rebound hypertension or myocardial ischemia.
